text: 22 May 2025, S4. Searched the moss cushions on the north slope for Sminthurinus, about thirty minutes; none found.
May 23, 2025, station S2. Two pitfall traps in the phrygana soil, emptied after 24 h: Lepidocyrtus lanuginosus, n = 7.
24.05.2025, S5. Compost heap again. Ceratophysella denticulata still swarming; counted 25 in the first of three trays and stopped.
25 May 2025, S1. Oak litter, Berlese 48 h. The tube cracked in transit and the sample dried out; nothing usable.
2025/05/26, S3. Grass litter, hand search, twenty minutes. Isotoma viridis, twelve individuals, all adults.
27 May 2025 at S2. Deep soil core 10-20 cm. Probably Pseudosinella alba, the eyes need checking; 4 specimens.
28 May 2025. Carob grove south of the road, station number not assigned. Leaf litter: Sminthurinus aureus x 2.
29th May 2025, S4. Bark of the old pine searched for Entomobrya nivalis for half an hour; nothing.
30 May 2025, S5. Cave, 15 m in from the entrance. Heteromurus cf. nitidus, two, both damaged.
31 May 2025, S1. The irrigation channel had flooded the track and I could not reach the oaks. No sample.
1 June 2025, S3. Moss on the terrace wall. Folsomia candida, about 30, not counted properly.
2 Jun 2025, S2. Phrygana soil under thyme. Isotoma virdis, nine adults and two juveniles; eleven in all.
3 June 2025, S4. Pine litter, Berlese 24 h only. Xenylla maritima, 16 ind., a species not on our list.
4 June 2025, S5. Compost. Ceratophysella denticulata, first tray 18, second tray not sorted yet.
June 5 2025, no station, roadside bank near the village. Dry soil, a single Folsomia candida.
